newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan brokerage share prices slip on dim outlook.
newsitem.headline: Japan brokerage share prices slip on dim outlook.

text.p: Shares in the Japanese securities sector slipped on Tuesday, depressed by worries over their future earnings after the proposed "Big Bang" financial reforms, traders said.
Shares in Nomura Securities Co Ltd closed 30 yen lower at 1,850 yen after hitting their lowest price for the year.
Other major firms also dropped to their lowest levels for the year before recovering slightly.
Daiwa Securities Co Ltd closed 20 yen lower at 1,180 yen. Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd lost 25 yen to close at 565 yen, while Nikko Securities Co Ltd fell 10 yen to close at 1,010 yen.
